_about: The platform record of the privileged operations self-healing sends (modules/nsot/privileged.py): the OSPF process resets (PROCESS_RESETS; board H section 5 and N17) and the BGP session clears (SESSION_CLEARS; board H 19.4 and N16, part H21, keyed by `measured_key`: the clear's key, IPv6's with -ipv6). Per dialect and operation: what the device ASKED when it was sent (`prompt`, or null when it asked nothing), what answered it (`answer`), how long it took to settle (`settle_s`, seconds: a reset's adjacencies formed again; a hard clear's session Established again; a soft clear's send to the device's prompt, its refresh's End-of-RIB inside it), and where and when it was measured (`device`, `at`). Written from a run on a real device (scripts/nmas-tier2-probe for the clears), never typed from memory. An operation with no row here is refused, naming why (`unmeasured`), and allows nothing. Whether an empty neighbour table prints nothing or a header is part of the same measurement.

clear-bgp-soft.device: the Default network's IOS-XE router whose eBGP neighbour is 198.51.100.3
clear-bgp-soft.evidence: scripts/nmas-tier2-probe --step bgp-soft (eBGP neighbour 198.51.100.3, route refresh and enhanced refresh both advertised and received), in a planned window declared first: the device printed its prompt and asked nothing; 2.4 s from the send to the prompt read back; Up/Down 2w2d before and after, 3 prefixes received before and after; read after through the reads engine: Established, Route Refresh sent 0 then 1, Refresh Epoch 1 then 2, Refresh End-of-RIB received about 1 s after it was sent, Connections established 1; dropped 0, Last reset never

clear-bgp-peer.device: the Default network's IOS-XE router whose eBGP neighbour is 198.51.100.3
clear-bgp-peer.evidence: scripts/nmas-tier2-probe --step bgp-hard --allow-live-bgp --bgp-peer 198.51.100.3, its planned window declared first (22:26:56 to 22:32:56 UTC, naming GigabitEthernet2): the device printed its prompt and asked nothing; the neighbour Established again 3.5 s after the send, read every second; Connections established 1 then 2, dropped 0 then 1, up for 2w2d then 00:00:01, Last reset never then 00:00:02, 3 prefixes received before and after

clear-bgp-soft-ipv6.device: the Default network's IOS-XE router whose IPv6 BGP neighbour is 2001:DB8:51:1::2
clear-bgp-soft-ipv6.evidence: scripts/nmas-tier2-probe --step bgp-soft --bgp-family ipv6 --allow-live-bgp --bgp-peer 2001:DB8:51:1::2: `clear bgp ipv6 unicast 2001:DB8:51:1::2 soft`, the device printed its prompt and asked nothing; 4.7 s from the send to the prompt read back; Up/Down 2w2d before and after; Connections established 1, dropped 0 before and after; Route Refresh sent 0 then 1; 3 prefixes received before and after
